The preserving of the integrity of the work allows the author to object to alteration, distortion, or mutilation of the work that is "prejudicial to the author's honor or reputation". Anything else that may detract from the artist's relationship with the work even after it leaves the artist's possession or ownership may bring these moral rights into play. Moral rights are distinct from any economic rights tied to copyrights. Even if an artist has assigned his or her copyright rights to a work to a third party, he or she still maintains the moral rights to the work." -Wikipedia

395.description: The service can view your search history and the websites you visit, which is an extremely intrusive way of collecting information that may include personal and/or sensitive data.

396.title: Your personal data may be sold unless you opt out
396.description: There is a form to opt-out (typically California's CCPA) of the selling of your personal data. This is a bad a point because there are many services that don't have this form due to not selling your data in the first place.

397.title: Your biometric data is collected
397.description: This service can collect or use your biometric data. This includes but is not limited to facial recognition, fingerprints, and iris scans. Although this feature can sometimes be convenient to the user, providing this type of information to the service could open your personal data to being sold or stolen.

398.title: This service has a no refund policy with some exceptions
398.description: Payments can be refunded if some requirements are fulfilled.

399.title: Your IP address is collected, which can be used to view your approximate location

400.title: This service receives your precise location through GPS coordinates
400.description: Unless the service relies on Geo Location, this case is to be assigned to points that don't need your GPS coordinates to function properly.

402.title: The service has non-exclusive use of your content
402.description: The service can pay for your content and you are allowed to make it commercially available to other services/parties.

403.title: Instead of asking directly, this Service will assume your consent to changes of terms merely from your usage
403.description: The Service infers your acceptance from your continued usage, instead of prompting you to read the new Terms and asking for direct consent. This doesn’t apply to services that have no way to seek consent from users through their contact details or an account.

404.title: This service provides a list of third parties involved in its operation
404.description: The service provides a list detailing the third parties involved, their roles, and may even provide more information.

407.title: Content you post may be edited by the service for any reason
407.description: This service can edit any content on the service for whatever the reason and at their sole discretion.

408.title: This service informs you that its Terms of Service does not apply to third-party services
408.description: The service states that whenever it links to third party websites or applications, its Terms of Service does not apply. Those third party websites or applications hosted or operated by other organizations may have their Terms of Service.

409.title: You must provide your identifiable information
409.description: The Service requires users to provide their identifiable information, including phone number, iD number or other information, even though this data collection isn’t essential for the purposes of the service. They may still allow pseudonyms in the foreground.

444.title: You are prohibited from publishing any third party’s personally identifiable information without their consent
444.description: Users agree not to publicly post personally identifiable information (name, postal address, contact information…) without the owner’s knowledge or consent

445.title: Harming minors in any ways is prohibited
445.description: This service prohibits harming minor in any ways. Since both “minor” and “in any ways” are vague and can be cited to restrict possibly any actions, the case is not classified as “good”.

478.title: You may still be tracked even after opting out from tracking
478.description: Users can’t fully opt out of tracking technologies used for non essential purposes such as advertising, marketing or analytics. The user may be asked for consent for installing some tracking technologies on the device, and even if all are rejected the service will still track its visitors and ignore the choice.This case doesn’t apply to functional cookies that are necessary to provide the services.

481.title: The service claims to be GDPR compliant for European users
481.description: The service has a different behavior towards users protected by the GDPR.

482.title: The service claims to be CCPA compliant for California users
482.description: The service has a different behavior towards users protected by the California Consumer Privacy Act.

483.title: The service claims to be LGPD compliant for Brazilian users
483.description: The service has a different behavior towards users protected by the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais.

484.title: You must report to the service any unauthorized use of your account or any breach of security
484.description: The service asks the user to notify them immediately of any unauthorized use or security breaches.

486.title: Minors must have the authorization of their legal guardians to use the service
486.description: Minors must have the authorization of their legal guardians to use the services. The legal guardians are responsible for the use of the service by the minor.

487.title: Sensitive data is collected and shared to target advertising
487.description: Sensitive data refers to information requiring special protection, such as health data, political and religious beliefs, ethnic origins, sexual life and financial information. The service collects and shares this data with third parties for advertising or marketing.

490.title: The service is only available in some countries approved by its government
490.description: Countries under embargo or banned by the government of the country in question cannot use the service.

492.title: Your provided identifiable information is actively checked by the service
492.description: The service checks if the required identifiable information you've provided is correct, and may do so on a regular basis. The check measures could be analyzing your browser information and/or providing the identifiable information to a third-party or the authority, thus compromising your anonymity.

493.title: This service is a subsidiary of Company X
493.description: The service is a subsidiary of a certain company (called X in the title, to be replaced by the parent Company in each point's title). Company X’s Terms of Service may apply to the service.

498.title: The service does not use any third-party advertising services
498.description: The service does not put any paid third party advertisements on their platform

499.title: The service suspends your account after inactivity for a certain or uncertain time

504.title: Your personal data is used for automated decision-making, profiling or AI training
504.description: Personal data or content you share with the service may be processed to make decisions by automated means without human involvement. This includes profiling, which is any form of automated processing of your information to analyse or predict things like your economic situation, health, personal preferences or interests; as well as Artificial Intelligence training.

517.title: You can opt out of binding arbitration, but might have reduced time to do so
517.description: The service allows you to opt out of its binding arbitration clause, though often you have to do so before a certain amount of time passes after your registration.

519.title: You must keep your information up to date and accurate
519.description: The service expects you to provide true and accurate information upon registering an account with them, and that you will keep it up to date.

521.title: Contact information from a Data Protection Officer (DPO) is provided
521.description: The service provides the contact information of a Data Protection Officer (DPO) to handle privacy requests and/or complaints.
